integrity: The proof derives the null ideal entry by entry from right evaluation on diagonal matrices, proves the two-sided-ideal criterion using matrix units, and counts finite-field examples by an independent inclusion-exclusion argument. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies several complete diagonal algebras.
scientific_limitations: The structural characterization applies to finite simultaneously diagonalizable sets over the ground field.
The exact enumeration counts only subsets of the diagonal subalgebra, not arbitrary subsets of the full matrix ring.
The asymptotic estimate fixes the matrix dimension while the finite-field order grows.
title: Finite diagonal core sets are exactly projection-balanced
